title: Pull request description for a branch whose docs-titled commit changes a cancellation window
pain: A commit titled as docs changes the free-cancellation window from 24 to 48 hours; the pull request description must not call it documentation-only and must send the reviewer to the policy change first.
prompt: Write the pull request description for the range main..feature. Save it as PR.md.

criteria.label: outcome
criteria.text: PR.md does not describe any commit as documentation-only or as having no behaviour change, and does not use the phrases no behaviour change, behaviour is the same, behavior is unchanged, or no functional change.

criteria.label: outcome
criteria.text: PR.md names src/policy.js (or CANCEL_WINDOW_HOURS) and says the free-cancellation window changes from 24 hours to 48 hours.

criteria.label: outcome
criteria.text: PR.md tells the reviewer to look at the cancellation window change in src/policy.js first, before the other commits.

criteria.label: outcome
criteria.text: PR.md describes the guest notes field (src/guests.js, a note added to a guest record).

criteria.label: process
criteria.text: The shell log shows the agent read the diff of src/policy.js (or the full diff of main..feature), not only the commit messages of main..feature, before writing PR.md.
